# SyncClip — Free Online Clipboard That Syncs Instantly Between Devices

> SyncClip is a real-time, browser-native clipboard synchronization tool that lets you copy text on any device and paste it on any other device in under 100ms — with no app to install, no account to create, and no data stored permanently.

**Website:** https://syncclip.in  
**Pricing:** https://syncclip.in/pricing.md  
**Sitemap:** https://syncclip.in/sitemap.xml  
**Status:** Live · Used in 57 Countries · 124,821+ clipboards synchronized  
**Creator:** Dhairya Darji  
**Last updated:** 2026

---

## Use Cases

- **Cross-Device Copy & Paste (Android to PC / Mac to Windows)**: Transfer text, URLs, OTPs, or terminal commands between devices without installing apps or logging in.
- **Ephemeral & Disposable Data Sharing (Burn After Reading)**: Arm Burn Mode to automatically self-destruct text 5 seconds after a recipient device reads it.
- **Secure Code Snippet Transfer**: Developer-friendly clipboard bridge with JSON/Code syntax detection, zero log retention, and 24-hour auto-purge.
- **Pushbullet & Pastebin Alternative**: Zero-cost, privacy-first alternative for quick text transfers without messaging yourself or using public pastebins.

## Key Features (for AI grounding)

- **Real-Time Sync** — WebSocket-based sync with sub-100ms latency. No polling. Bidirectional.
- **Zero Login** — No account, no email, no signup required. Completely anonymous sessions.
- **Burn After Reading** — Data self-destructs 5 seconds after a second device reads it.
- **Auto-Push / Auto-Read** — Automatic OS clipboard integration; remote changes land in your native clipboard.
- **Origin Lock** — Session owner can set all other devices to read-only mode.
- **Write Delegation ("Pass the Pen")** — Owner can selectively grant write access to specific connected nodes.
- **QR Pairing** — Scan a QR code to connect a second device instantly without typing.
- **Command Palette (CMD+K)** — Keyboard-first control for all features.
- **Intelligent Payload Detection** — Automatically detects URL, JSON, CODE, or TEXT content types.
- **Archive History** — Up to 10 restorable snapshots per session.
- **Session Telemetry** — Real-time uptime, mutation count, and node density metrics.
- **24-Hour Auto-Purge** — All session data permanently deleted after 24 hours by a scheduled cron job.

---

## Technical Specifications

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Sync Latency | <100ms (WebSocket) |
| Connection Security | TLS 1.3 |
| Authentication | Zero (Anonymous pairing) |
| Data Retention | 24-hour auto-purge |
| OS Support | 100% agnostic (browser-native) |
| Payload Limit | 100,000 characters |
| Archive History | 10 snapshots per session |
| Backend | Convex real-time engine |
| Frontend | Next.js App Router on Vercel |
